questions.title: Replicas
questions.content: Why run more than one replica of a deployment?

options.text: So the application stays up when one pod fails
options.explanation: Kubernetes keeps the other replicas serving while it replaces the failed pod.

options.text: So each pod gets more CPU
options.explanation: Replicas add pods; CPU per pod is set by resource requests and limits.

options.text: So the cluster adds a node
options.explanation: Replicas do not add nodes; the cluster's node count is managed separately.

questions.explanation: More replicas keep the application available when a pod fails.
hints: Think about what happens when one pod fails.

learningObjectives: Explain why a deployment runs more than one replica.
